environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task but deployed with additional operational constraints. The task definition specifies a read-only root filesystem with explicit tmpfs mounts only at /tmp/reports (noexec). The container uses a custom-built distroless image where wkhtmltopdf is compiled with the --disable-local-file-access patch (qt webkit local file access disabled at compile time). VPC configuration includes PrivateLink-only egress via a restrictive security group that allows outbound only to the S3 gateway endpoint (prefix list pl-63a5400a) and the ECR endpoints. A VPC endpoint policy on the S3 gateway restricts to s3:GetObject on the specific config bucket ARN only. The task ENI security group has no rule permitting traffic to 169.254.169.254 or 169.254.170.2 link-local ranges (explicitly denied via a /16 deny in the NACL on the subnet). DNS resolution is handled by Route53 Resolver with a firewall rule group that blocks resolution of any domain not in an explicit allow-list (*.amazonaws.com, internal.corp.example.com).

config.filesystem: read-only rootfs, tmpfs at /tmp/reports with noexec
config.network_security_group_egress: allow TCP 443 to pl-63a5400a (S3 gateway) and com.amazonaws.us-east-1.ecr.dkr only
config.nacl: explicit DENY on 169.254.0.0/16 for both inbound and outbound on task subnet
config.route53_resolver_firewall: BLOCK action on all domains except *.amazonaws.com and internal.corp.example.com
config.wkhtmltopdf_compile_flags: --disable-local-file-access (prevents file:// and local resource loading in QtWebKit renderer)
